### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one viralmetagenome run (overview-tables/, preprocessing/, assembly/, consensus/, variants/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional sample metadata table (TSV), the one given to --metadata: sample id in a column named sample (or in the first column), one column per factor. Enables the design filters and grouping. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Metadata sample-id column. Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Column the dashboards group and filter samples by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE; without it, any factor of the samples overview's metadata block. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (15 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`checkv/quality_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/checkv/quality_summary.py) | One row per viral sequence from CheckV's ``quality_summary.tsv``. | `sample`, `checkv_run`, `contig_id`, `contig_length`, `provirus`, `proviral_length`, `gene_count`, `viral_genes`, `host_genes`, `checkv_quality`, `miuvig_quality`, `completeness`, `completeness_method`, `contamination`, `kmer_freq`, `warnings` |
| [`ivar/variants_tsv.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ivar/variants_tsv.py) | One row per variant from the raw iVar ``variants`` table, one file per mapping. | `sample`, `reference`, `route`, `genome_id`, `chrom`, `pos`, `ref`, `alt`, `variant_type`, `variant_key`, `ref_dp`, `alt_dp`, `total_dp`, `af`, `frequency_class`, `alt_qual`, `pval`, `filter`, `gff_feature`, `aa_change` |
| [`mosdepth/cumulative_coverage.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/cumulative_coverage.py) | Cumulative coverage curve per mapping, from mosdepth's ``global.dist.txt``. | `sample`, `reference`, `genome_id`, `depth`, `bases_pct` |
| [`mosdepth/per_base_bins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/per_base_bins.py) | Read depth along each reference, binned, from mosdepth's ``per-base.bed.gz``. | `sample`, `reference`, `genome_id`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `position`, `mean_depth`, `min_depth` |
| [`nf-core/viralmetagenome/genomes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/viralmetagenome/recipes/genomes.py) | Consensus genome hub for nf-core/viralmetagenome: one row per final consensus. | `genome_id`, `sample`, `reference`, `route`, `step`, `virus`, `consensus_length`, `n_bases`, `n_pct`, `annotation_identity_pct`, `annotation_aligned_pct`, `annotation_mismatches`, `blast_identity_pct`, `blast_aligned_bp`, `blast_bitscore`, `checkv_contamination`, `checkv_genes`, `checkv_viral_genes`, `checkv_host_genes`, `mapped_reads`, `mapped_pct`, `properly_paired_pct`, `error_rate`, `insert_size`, `dup_read_pairs`, `dup_pct`, `dedup_mapped_reads`, `mean_depth`, `median_depth`, `max_depth`, `cov_1x_pct`, `cov_10x_pct`, `cov_50x_pct`, `cov_100x_pct`, `snps`, `indels`, `variant_records`, `transitions`, `transversions`, `ts_tv`, `mash_identity`, `cluster_members`, `annotation_name`, `annotation_acronym`, `annotation_level`, `annotation_taxid`, `annotation_segment`, `annotation_host`, `annotation_subject`, `blast_hit`, `checkv_quality`, `miuvig_quality`, `checkv_warnings`, `mash_reference`, `mash_shared_hashes`, `cluster_centroid`, `constraint_species`, `constraint_segment`, `constraint_definition`, `blast_query_cover_pct`, `checkv_completeness`, `completeness_method` |
| [`nf-core/viralmetagenome/read_funnel.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/viralmetagenome/recipes/read_funnel.py) | Read pairs per sample at each preprocessing stage, long, for the read funnel figure. | `sample`, `stage`, `stage_order`, `read_pairs`, `pct_of_raw` |
| [`nf-core/viralmetagenome/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/viralmetagenome/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub for nf-core/viralmetagenome: one row per sample, its reads and its assembly. | `sample`, `raw_read_pairs`, `raw_gc_pct`, `raw_dup_pct`, `trimmed_reads`, `q30_pct`, `fastp_dup_pct`, `adapter_pct`, `trimmed_read_pairs`, `host_pct`, `host_filtered_read_pairs`, `retained_pct`, `assembly_length`, `assembly_n50`, `clusters`, `removed_clusters`, `mean_cluster_size`, `singletons`, `denovo_consensus` |
